request.operator_approval: Operator explicitly directed that #522 remain open until #833 completes and all new review findings are fixed.

mutation.body:
## Outcome

Produce one complete finding-disposition ledger for the accepted-finding denominator, including the immutable-candidate external review owned by #833 and every finding it returns.

## Primary deliverable

One finding-disposition ledger binding each accepted finding to a reviewed fix or explicit owned deferral.

## Verification result

The finding census reports every accepted finding exactly once with evidence, owner, disposition, and review identity.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one complete finding-disposition ledger; individual remediations remain separately reviewable evidence.

## Dependencies and closure gate

- TAIL-05 retained review record: #521
- Immutable-candidate external review: #833
- #522 must remain open until #833 is complete, every new finding has exactly one disposition, every release-blocking finding is fixed and independently reviewed at its exact implementation head, and the final ledger proves the complete denominator.
- A successful #833 review with no findings does not close #522 automatically; the final ledger is still required.

## Retained predecessor scope

- #188

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] #833 reviews the explicit immutable candidate and records reviewer identity, limitations, validation, findings, and drift result.
- [ ] Every retained and newly returned finding has exactly one disposition.
- [ ] Every substantive fix has exact-head review.
- [ ] Every deferral names owner, rationale, and target milestone.
- [ ] No release-blocking finding remains unresolved when #522 closes.

## Owned paths

- docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/release/tail-06/**

## PVF lanes

- finding-census
- remediation-proof
- deferral-truth

## Stop conditions

- #833 is incomplete.
- A release-blocking finding remains.
- The final finding denominator is incomplete or stale.

## Non-goals

- Silent deferral.
- Closing #522 merely because #833 completed.
- Ceremony.

## Canonical planning identity

- Planned ID: TAIL-06
- Canonical title: [v0.92.1][TAIL-06] Review findings remediation
